title: Affine etale section cocone is a colimit
statement: Let I be a nonempty directed preorder, D : I^op → Scheme a diagram of qcqs schemes with affine transitions, c a limit cone, i₀ a stage, G a sheaf of sets on D(i₀), and W₀ an affine etale object over D(i₀) with quasi-compact and quasi-separated structure map. The canonical cocone of stage section sets [def-weil-pbc-affine-section-cocone] is a colimit cocone in Type (u+1). This asserts the universal property for all compatible maps out of the entire section diagram, not merely eventual equality of a specified pair.

proof.text: Restrict to the directed upper tail over i₀. It is nonempty and cofinal, and the restricted cone is still limiting. Limit projections are affine. Apply the affine etale site colimit presentation of Tag 0EYL, including its strictification and compatibility with base changes.

Restrict the full-site sheaves to the affine sites via the restriction equivalences. The inverse-image comparison preserves adjunction units and composition, so the section diagram and its cone legs become exactly the specified canonical maps. Pulling the inverse images of G to the limit yields a system isomorphic to the constant system on the limit inverse image of G, using the unit-compatible composition isomorphisms. This nonempty filtered category is connected, hence the constant system has this sheaf as colimit.

Apply the varying-site section theorem of Tag 09YN on the base changes of W₀ in the affine site. It identifies the colimit of the stage section sets with the sections of the sheaf colimit. Transport its universal property and legs back through the full/affine equivalences. The unit equations identify these legs with the constructed section cocone, proving its IsColimit property. The existing fixed-site ColimitSiteSections theorem supplies only the section-evaluation part; the varying-site identifications still require formalization.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09YQ and 0EYL; Sites Tag 09YN; concrete functor and cocone formulation by M3. Source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YN and /tag/0EYL.

lean.statement: theorem etaleStageSectionCocone_isColimit {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (i₀ : I) (G : Sheaf (D.obj (op i₀)).smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (W₀ : (D.obj (op i₀)).Etale) [QuasiCompact W₀.hom] [QuasiSeparated W₀.hom] [IsAffine W₀.left] : Nonempty (IsColimit (etaleStageSectionCocone D c i₀ G W₀))
